user_query: My company is planning a marketing campaign and we need some suggestions for catchy slogans. Can you provide us with some creative tagline ideas? Also, show us some trending images related to advertising.

TaskList.description: Gather and analyze current marketing slogans trending in the industry to generate creative tagline ideas.
Compile a list of creative tagline ideas based on the analysis from Subtask 1.
Fetch trending images related to advertising from social media and image databases.
Present the creative tagline ideas and trending images as a marketing campaign proposal.
